Enhance your creative projects with this beautiful collection of aesthetic linen beige daisy and stripes seamless patterns. Inspired by cottagecore and rustic farmhouse vibes, these neutral neutral-toned digital papers are perfect for a wide range of crafts, stationary, and digital designs.

Digital scrapbooking and journaling
